entities.name: PMID:25423015
observations: In 372 Mexican first-degree relatives of patients with type 2 diabetes, obese normal-glucose-tolerant relatives with triglycerides ≥150 mg/dL had 21%–60% higher HOMA2-β than all comparison groups.
Study assessed β-cell function using OGTT-derived HOMA2-β; triglycerides correlated positively with β-cell function among obese subjects (Spearman ρ=0.502, P<0.001).

entities.name: Increased beta-cell function
observations: Obese first-degree relatives of patients with type 2 diabetes who had elevated triglycerides exhibited increased β-cell function versus all other study groups, by 21%–60% (P<0.05).

entities.name: Obese high-TG relatives
observations: First-degree relatives of patients with type 2 diabetes; obese, normal glucose tolerant, and triglycerides ≥150 mg/dL.
β-cell function was estimated with OGTT-derived HOMA2-β.
